summary: Verified the manifest fix (frontend-only) as requested. All 5 test criteria PASS in preview: (1) /manifest.json returns 200 and now references /aditya-logo.png for both 192x192 and 512x512 icons (both maskable). (2) /logo192.png and /logo512.png fallback copies return 200 with content-type image/png (8580 bytes each, valid PNG). (3) /aditya-logo.png regression: still 200, 8580 bytes, valid PNG (unchanged). (4) Home page https://acct-workflow-1.preview.emergentagent.com/ loads normally — header renders, hero + product carousel + services strip visible, zero manifest-related console errors ('manifest', 'logo192', 'logo512', 'aditya-logo', 'Download error or resource isn\'t a valid image' — all 0 hits). Only remaining console errors are: 3 generic 404s (banners/ai_banner_633d2db6.png missing, /api/promotions/active-theme/ aborted, /cdn-cgi/rum aborted) and google-analytics.com blocked by headless browser — all pre-existing, unrelated to this fix, and the GA block is the same client-side ad-blocker issue the user reported (not a code fix). (5) Bosch KGN56LB42I PDP (/refrigerator/KGN56LB42I) regression PASS — exactly 1 offer card (offer-card-*), exactly 1 WhatsApp CTA (data-testid=offer-whatsapp-<uuid>) with text 'Contact Us on WhatsApp to Redeem', target=_blank, href starts with https://wa.me/919844577440?text=Hi%20Aditya%20Retail. Backend /api/offers/product/{id} still returns 1 offer (no_cost_emi, online) with whatsapp_message populated. No console errors on PDP. Manifest fix is production-ready; user will need to redeploy to reach adityaretail.com.

issues: Both icons declare sizes '192x192' and '512x512' but the referenced /aditya-logo.png is actually 250x85 (non-square). Chrome may still emit a low-severity size-mismatch WARNING in future audits (not the 'resource isn\'t a valid image' error which was caused by the 404 and is now resolved). Not blocking, but for a fully clean Lighthouse PWA audit, consider generating true 192x192 and 512x512 square PNGs and pointing each icon entry to its correctly-sized file.

action_items: Optional (non-blocking): Generate true 192x192 and 512x512 square PNG icons and update manifest.json to point each icon slot at its correctly-sized file for a fully clean PWA audit. Current fix (both pointing to /aditya-logo.png 250x85) resolves the reported 'Download error or resource isn\'t a valid image' console warning but leaves a latent size-mismatch note.
Redeploy frontend to production so adityaretail.com picks up the fix (user-facing action).
critical_code_review_comments: manifest.json shortcuts entries (lines 33, 40, 47) still reference /logo192.png. That path now exists as a fallback copy, so it works, but if you later remove the /logo192.png fallback these shortcut icons would 404 again. Keep the fallback or update shortcut src to /aditya-logo.png for consistency with the top-level icons array.
Verified icon files are byte-identical copies of aditya-logo.png (all 8580 bytes, PNG 250x85 RGBA). Safe fallback.
